compiled_guest_prototype.assumptions: Caller owns live aligned object/control/session/epoch. Sequential trusted completion is a fixture, never Sony ABI or real generation.

source_anchors.role: Original descriptor copy prefix; actual runtime clear and object construction still outside exercised region.
Original matched-row marshalling and preset selection caller; state/log/buffer/channel prerequisites remain unexecuted.
Original preset selector writes common+e000; must share real synchronization/lifetime with prototype to prevent bypass.
Original packer reads selected pointer and builds target/trace/CPB fields; producer and prepared output are separate dependencies.
Next unexecuted fields; full parameter object, allocation, publication and HAL dependencies must be closed before whole-request claim.
Selected-record default decoder, not real encoder/HAL or bitstream feedback.

required_bindings: Actual object identity and original-byte/runtime mapping validation, session registration, trusted current configuration epoch and recording-idle admission.
Caller ABI, installation/removal sites, shared synchronization with all original selector/configuration writers/readers; prototype atomics alone do not synchronize Sony consumers.
Register before dependent parameter publication; transfer ownership through every copy/queue/cache/HAL edge; trusted completion and cancellation for every failure route.
Closed admission plus drained producers/prepared packets and actual consumers; separate code-entry prevention, in-flight code exit and native instruction publication/readback before unload.
Unify upstream FF quality/model and16M identity, query/cache/mux/time estimate; complete original parameter object/header/HAL and actual output acceptance.
Same-body healthy backup, restricted restore/readback, WBI/cold boot and independent rescue; preserve physical completion gates.

design_references.scope: Acquire/Release pairing only; no evidence of Sony synchronization integration.
Removal/reclamation principle only; no claim Sony uses RCU or that prototype can reclaim code.
